favourite.heading: Why Miami can pull away
bullets: Miami is the better football team by 15.0 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-15.0 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Miami by 2.3 points: ball control vs front disruption (-2.3 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Wake Forest can keep it close
bullets: Playing at Wake Forest is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -36.2 to p90 +7.8 for Wake Forest, so a projection of -13.2 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 9.3 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
